settings.q: Can you model our specific equipment?

settings.q: Can finishes and colours match our real unit?
settings.a: Yes, colours, logos and markings are reproduced so the model is unmistakably yours.

settings.title: A dream come true
settings.body: I’m a West Ham fan and it was my dream to get this cup. The size and detail are spot on. I will treasure it.

settings.name: James T.
settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: A precise scale replica of your industrial water cooled chiller unit equipment - pumps, units or control gear reproduced in detail and presented under a clear case. The ideal showcase and corporate gift for equipment, engineering and manufacturing firms.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your equipment, colours, branding and display case
settings.s1_body: Hard to bring a pump skid, chiller or control unit into a meeting? We build it in miniature. This scale model reproduces your equipment down to its panels, piping and fittings, finished under a clear case so it stays pristine on a desk, reception counter or exhibition stand. A memorable showcase piece and corporate gift for equipment and engineering companies - we model whichever unit best represents your business.
settings.case_body: Commissioned by Biatherm equipment company, these cased models let the team showcase their units at exhibitions and sales office - a tangible, branded reminder of the kit they supply, far more memorable than a brochure.
settings.case_quote: Clients loved seeing a miniature of the exact unit we make. A brilliant talking point in every meeting.
settings.prov_p: A scale model brings equipment that's too big for the boardroom right onto the table - cased, branded and built to last. It's a sales aid and a showpiece in one.
